evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-2002-007
evidence.claim: In 2002, re-weighing on scale SC-2B was introduced as a temporary measure until scale SC-2 was replaced due to drift.
evidence.quote: re-weigh every pigment addition on bench scale SC-2B and countersign, until scale SC-2 is replaced

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-2002-011
evidence.claim: A 2002 deviation report linked off-shade and low hiding power in AF-12 to a 3% under-weighing caused by drift in scale SC-2.
evidence.quote: Cause: pigment under-weighed by about 3 % on scale SC-2 (drift)

evidence.title: MAINTENANCE LOG – PLATFORM SCALE SC-2 (extract 2000-2002)
evidence.claim: In 2002, scale SC-2 showed a drift of -3.0% due to load cell ageing, and replacement was recommended.
evidence.quote: 30/10/2002 SC-2 calibration: drift -3.0 %. Load cell ageing; replacement to be budgeted.

evidence.title: Equipment record EQ-2014-005 - weighing system WS-10
evidence.claim: In 2014, the problematic scale SC-2 was replaced by the WS-10 weighing system with automatic recording.
evidence.quote: Platform scale SC-2 replaced by load-cell weighing system WS-10 integrated with the MES: automatic recording of every addition

evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: As of 2021, scale SC-2B is still listed as equipment used in the QP-02 Batch QC release plan.

verdict.instruction: Re-weigh every pigment addition on bench scale SC-2B and countersign.
verdict.reason: The step was introduced as a temporary measure to mitigate pigment under-weighing caused by drift in scale SC-2 (E1, E2, E3). Scale SC-2 was replaced in 2014 by the WS-10 system, which provides automatic recording of additions (E4), removing the original reason for the manual re-weighing.

chain.claim: Re-weighing on SC-2B was a temporary measure due to drift in scale SC-2

dependencies.name: drift in scale SC-2
dependencies.note: SC-2 was replaced by WS-10 in 2014

counter_evidence.claim: Scale SC-2B is still listed as equipment in the 2021 quality plan
counter_evidence.resolution: Listing equipment in a plan does not validate the original reason for the step if the hazard (SC-2 drift) is gone.
